topic.title: Only paying the minimum on your credit card: what it really costs you

cta: Look for the three-year line on your next statement
title: Only paying the minimum on a $5,000 card? Here is the real cost
description:
Rohan owes $5,000 on his credit card and pays the minimum, on time, every month. It feels responsible. We follow that balance down a long road and compute how many years it really takes and what it costs in total.
Then the same balance with one fixed payment that clears it in three years, the two roads side by side.
And the line on a US card statement that already shows you the fix.

Speak to a licensed financial adviser in your country before making financial decisions.
Illustrative only. Not financial advice.
